description: A previously optional field becomes required.
rationale: A request that omits the now-required field is rejected, so the migration has to start sending it. Kept deliberately as a known limitation: impact analysis locates affected code by matching names that appear in it, and a field the repository has never sent appears nowhere, so there is no anchor to find. Rewire is expected to fail this case today; it is in the dataset so that stops being invisible.
